    Visualize feature-metabolite MS/MS spectra

    visualize_feature_metabolite_spectra.Rd

    Visualize feature-metabolite MS/MS spectra

    visualize_feature_metabolite_spectra(
  spectra_top = NULL,
  spectra_bottom = NULL,
  name_top = NULL,
  name_bottom = NULL,
  type = c("mirrored", "overlapped"),
  peak_number = FALSE,
  match_matrix = NULL
)

    Arguments

    spectra_top

    MS/MS spectrum as two-columns data.frame

    spectra_bottom

    MS/MS spectrum as two-columns data.frame

    name_top

    name for top spectrum

    name_bottom

    name for bottom spectrum

    type

    mirrored or overlapped visualization

    peak_number

    whether to show the peak number or not

    match_matrix

    match matrix calculated by metabolite_identi

    Value

    ggplot object
